$comment: Project settings for the Iconik Employee app. Checked in on purpose, so the
card-drift gate travels with the repo rather than living in one machine's
check_card_drift.py blocks a Write/Edit that hand-rolls a new card (a
rounded, filled, shadowed container) anywhere outside DesignSystem/. It
exists because the previous card modifier, cardStyle(), shipped during the
audit roadmap's Phase 3 with ZERO adopters while 115 hand-rolled cards were
written around it. See scripts/check_card_drift.py and AMBIENT_ROLLOUT_PLAN.md.
The gate fails OPEN on any error, and its allowlist is generated from the
rule itself (python3 scripts/check_card_drift.py --list), so it starts green
and only catches new drift. Each AMB phase deletes its surface's entry.
The existence test around the command is load-bearing, not defensive habit.
PreToolUse treats exit 2 as BLOCK, and python3 exits 2 when it cannot open
the script — so a bare invocation with a missing or moved script would
refuse EVERY Write and Edit in the project, with an error that never
mentions cards. Since this file is checked in, that would happen on the
